Filtered Relevant Items:
1. [6] “Error loading configuration: fork/exec /build/packer-plugin-arm-image: exec format error”

External Knowledge Summary:
- A similar loader failure occurred when an expected executable was not placed in the directory used to build/run the application.
- Moving the built binary into the expected `build` directory resolved that reported issue.
- The discussion also identified CPU architecture mismatch and multi-architecture builds as possible causes of an `exec format error`, though that was not the confirmed cause there.
